_comment: Decode-chip DSE for Qwen3-14B. Full mixed-precision space: MXINT and MXFP searched on weights, KV and activations. The weights-stay-MXINT rule was derived on the shared prefill+decode chip; the dedicated decode chip re-derives it, since at equal element width the format is free on the HBM stream. GPTQ + Erry clip weights, selective rotation on activations/KV, task-aligned calibration. Search objectives are the analytic model's end-to-end TPS/TPOT on the fixed reference chip; co-design runs in Stage B.
_gpu_comment: Shared A6000s: each trial picks the freest GPU at spawn. RTN PPL-only workers collapse the FP bank (~1x model resident, ~19 GiB peak); GPTQ/rotation + task workers keep both phase banks (~2x model + generation KV).
_scratch_comment: GPTQ/rotation weight banks are ~14 GiB each (per-layer safetensors). Root /tmp has only ~16 GiB free — too small for even one bank, which is what caused the 'No space left on device' Stage-2 failures. /home has ~96 GiB free and is writable; banks are transient (cleared after use) so peak stays ~1-2 banks.
